---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible problem with the gateway or a supported adapter
title: "bug: "
labels: bug
---

## Summary

Describe the problem in one or two sentences.

## Environment

- OS:
- Node.js version:
- Python version:
- Gateway commit/version:
- Backend affected: Gemini / Qwen / ChatGPT / Router / UI / Other

## Reproduction

1. Start the relevant services.
2. Call the affected endpoint or open the affected UI mode.
3. Provide the smallest request that reproduces the issue.

## Expected behavior

What should have happened?

## Actual behavior

What happened instead? Include the HTTP status and sanitized logs when relevant.

## Security / credentials

Never paste API keys, cookies, browser session exports or other secrets into an issue.

## Additional context

Include provider-side changes, model identifiers, streaming/non-streaming mode, and any useful request/response details after removing sensitive data.
